description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableAcknowledgements class, verifying its immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and retrieval methods related to acknowledgement handling within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.acks.base package.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgementsTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ImmutableAcknowledgements class.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes static data used across tests, such as sample acknowledgements and their JSON representations.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods for ImmutableAcknowledgements.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the ImmutableAcknowledgements class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullAcknowledgements
methods.description: Ensures that passing null acknowledgements throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithEmptyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Ensures that passing an empty acknowledgements list throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithAcknowledgementsWithDifferentEntityIds
methods.description: Checks that acknowledgements with different entity IDs are rejected.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures that passing null DittoHeaders throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that toJson output matches the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: getEntityReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getEntity returns the correct JSON representation.

methods.name: getStatusCodeWithOneItem
methods.description: Validates getStatusCode behavior with a single acknowledgement.

methods.name: getStatusCodeWithMultipleItemsWithSameStatusCode
methods.description: Checks getStatusCode when multiple acknowledgements have the same status code.

methods.name: getStatusCodeWithMultipleItemsWithDivergentStatusCodes
methods.description: Verifies getStatusCode returns FAILED_DEPENDENCY when acknowledgements have different status codes.

methods.name: getMissingAcknowledgementLabelsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures getMissingAcknowledgementLabels correctly identifies missing acknowledgements.

methods.name: getSuccessfulAcknowledgementsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that getSuccessfulAcknowledgements filters acknowledgements with success status.

methods.name: getFailedAcknowledgementsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getFailedAcknowledgements filters acknowledgements with failure status.

methods.name: iteratorDoesNotAllowModification
methods.description: Ensures the iterator is unmodifiable.

methods.name: getSizeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the size reporting of immutable acknowledgements.

methods.name: isEmptyReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks whether the acknowledgements collection reports empty correctly.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests retrieval of specific acknowledgment by label.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of the associated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: responseRequiredIsSetToFalse
methods.description: Checks that getDittoHeaders().isResponseRequired() is false.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that setting new DittoHeaders creates a new immutable instance with updated headers.

methods.name: getEntityIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Confirms that getEntityId returns the expected entity ID.

methods.name: getEntityTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Confirms that getEntityType returns the expected entity type.

methods.name: getTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getType returns the correct string prefix for acknowledgements.

methods.name: getEntityWith2AcksReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates getting entity JSON with multiple acknowledgements.

methods.name: getEntityWith1AckReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates getting entity JSON with a single acknowledgement.
